title: Process: AGENTS.md and the gh-issues skill say when an issue gets source:qa

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:low
labels.description: Mechanical, one file, no new logic (issue-worker-low)

body:
## The maintainer's words

Maintainer decision on #2582, 2026-11-22: "Each issue that a run files gets a `source:qa` label." and "The coordinator files the sub-issues, each P7, and creates the label."

## What exists

- The label `source:qa` exists now: "Found by the QA swarm (exploratory agent runs on real parts)".
- `AGENTS.md`, Issue Law, rule "Agent-opened issues say so", names only `source:agent`.
- The `gh-issues` skill (`.claude/skills/gh-issues/SKILL.md`) does not name `source:qa`.

## Open point (a proposal, not the maintainer's words)

The decision does not say if `source:qa` comes with `source:agent` or in place of it. Proposal: an issue that a QA run files gets `source:qa` with `source:agent`. Reason: the rule "Agent-opened issues say so" stays true, and the enhancement lane order ("issues filed by a user (no `source:agent`) first") does not change. The maintainer can change this in the PR review.

## Necessary work

1. In `AGENTS.md`, rule "Agent-opened issues say so", add one sentence: an issue that a QA swarm run files also gets `source:qa`, with `source:agent`.
2. In `.claude/skills/gh-issues/SKILL.md`, section "Writing an issue", name `source:qa` and when to set it.
3. Keep each sentence in ASD-STE100. Do not rename the bold rule name.
4. The PR body has the line `Process change: yes`. The PR does not change `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`.

## Done means

- `AGENTS.md` and the `gh-issues` skill say when an issue gets `source:qa`, and that it comes with `source:agent` (or the rule that the maintainer chose).
- The PR has `Process change: yes` and no change to `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`.

This is a process change: `AGENTS.md` and `.claude/skills/` are process files.

Refs #2582
